text: Hello everyone, welcome to our English class.My name is Xin Zhenzhen, nice to meet you.You've learned about different jobs.Have you ever thought about what you would like to be in the future?In this lesson, you will read a poem, what would you like to be, and learn how to write a poem about your ideal job.Before we start our lesson, please make sure that you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, worksheet and pens.Please prepare your textbook, notebook, worksheet and pens.Are you ready?Now let's start.Look at the picture.Kitty, Alice, Joe and Peter are talking about their ideal jobs.What would Kitty like to be?She would like to be a nurse.What would Alice like to be?She would like to be a teacher.What would Joe like to be?He would like to be a fireman.How about Peter?He would like to be a pilot.How about you?What would you like to be?Today, you will write a poem about your ideal job.What can you write about?Think it over.You can write about what you would like to be.And you can write about the reasons why you would like to do the job.Now, read this poem and answer the questions.You will have half a minute.Time is up.Can you tell what the poem is about?The poem is about Peter and Kitty's ideal jobs.Who do you and I in the first verse refer to?They both refer to Peter, right?How do you know that?The first picture shows that Peter would like to be a pilot.You can know that Peter wrote this poem.Did Peter tell the readers his and Kitty's ideal jobs directly?No, he didn't.The first verse starts with a question.Someone asked Peter what he would like to be.Then Peter told him or her his ideal job.So you see, the poem is a dialogue between Peter and someone else.The second verse also starts with a question.This time, Peter told this person Kitty's ideal job.We learned the poem I have a good friend in unit 2.It is a rhyming poem as it has rhyming words in each verse.How about this poem?What features does this poem have?Now, read the poem again and answer the questions.You will have one minute.Ready?Is it a rhyming poem?It isn't a rhyming poem, is it?Then, what's special about the poem?You've got it!The question in the first verse is repeated.Why did the writer repeat this question?Because Peter wanted to show the other person's strong interest in his and Kitty's ideal jobs.Look at the fourth line of the first verse.What does the word that refer to?Yes, it refers to the job, a pilot.How about that in the fourth line of the second verse?It refers to the job, a nurse.What can we learn from the last line of each verse?The last line of each verse is to emphasize that Peter really wants to be a pilot and Kitty really wants to be a nurse.每节诗的最后一句都是在强调Peter和Kitty所期望的理想职业。Now, can you sum up the features of this poem?The question in each verse is repeated.The third line in each verse is the answer.Well, the last line is to emphasize the wish.Therefore, the poem sounds cheerful and it is easy to remember.Now, read Peter's poem aloud.I would like to be you.I would like to be a pilot.That's what I would like to be.That's what she would like to be.Now read with the recording.Do you feel the cheerful tone in this poem?Do you want to write a poem like this?Now, can you follow the same pattern and write the first verse about your ideal job?This is the first part of task one on your worksheet.When you write the verse, please remember to repeat the question, answer the question, and then emphasize your wish.You will have one and a half minutes.This is Victor's writing.Let's read it together.I'd like to be a doctor.Did Victor repeat the question?Yes, he did.Did he answer this question?Yes, he would like to be a doctor.And he emphasized his wish at the end of the verse.Well done, Victor.In Peter's poem, he only told us his and Kitty's ideal jobs.What else can he write about?Yes, the reasons why he would like to be a pilot and why Kitty would like to be a nurse.Peter has written another verse to explain why he would like to be a pilot.Read this verse and find out if he followed the same pattern of the poem.Why would you like to be a pilot?Because I want to fly a plane.That's why I would like to be a pilot.Did Peter repeat this question in the verse?Yes, he repeated the question.Yes, he would like to be a pilot because he wants to fly a plane.And he also emphasized the reason in the fourth line.This verse follows the same pattern of the poem.Now, help Peter complete the verse about why Kitty would like to be a nurse.Can you guess the reason?Maybe it's because Kitty likes helping others.Remember, when you write this verse, you need to give proper reasons and follow the tips as well.This is task two on your worksheet.Start!This is Lily's writing.Why would Kitty like to be a nurse?Because she wants to take care of sick people.That's why she would like to be a nurse.Lily repeated the question and then she gave the reason.It's because Kitty wants to take care of sick people.At last, Lily emphasized the reason.Well done, Lily.Now, boys and girls, do you know how to complete your poem?Write the second verse about why you would like to do the job.This is the second part of task one.That's why she would like to take care of sick people.时间到了,Victor已经完成了第二词,让我们一起看一看。Why would you like to be a doctor?Because I want to make sick people better.That's why I would like to be a doctor.In this verse, did Victor repeat the question?Did Victor answer the question?Yes, he gave a proper reason in the third line.Did he emphasize the reason why he would like to be a doctor?He did.He wrote, that's why I would like to be a doctor.Now, Victor's poem is completed.Wow, Victor, you know how to write a poem now.In this lesson, you've learned about the features of the poem,What would you like to be?And you've written a poem,What would you like to be?with similar pattern.After class, please finish the exercises on your homework sheet.Thank you so much for today.See you next time.
